name: My Bloody Valentine
label: Creation Records
lede: Two Dublin teenagers who met at a karate tournament spent a decade finding their sound, then took Creation through two and a half years and nineteen studios to make Loveless. The next album took another twenty-two.

hero.by: My Bloody Valentine in Manchester, 2013. Wikimedia Commons

eras.title: Dublin to West Berlin and back to London
eras.text: Kevin Shields and Colm Ó Cíosóig started in a Dublin punk band and named their next one after a slasher film. Advice from Gavin Friday sent them to the Netherlands, paperwork sent them to West Berlin, and by the end of 1985 they were in London with a new bassist.

years.h: Shields and Ó Cíosóig meet at a karate tournament
years.p: The two are introduced at a tournament in South Dublin and form a punk band, the Complex, with Liam Ó Maonlaí, later of [[Hothouse Flowers|9ddb555e-4cf2-4d76-a9d5-7627988cf6ab]].

years.h: A horror-film trailer names the band
years.p: Singer [[David Conway|d60351d4-bfed-4abe-9e69-4801cb63b57d]], performing as Dave Stelfox, suggests My Bloody Valentine after the 1981 slasher film. Bassist Mark Loughlin and guitarist Stephen Ivers fill out the first line-up, rehearsing in Smithfield and Temple Bar.

years.h: A four-track demo in Killiney wins a deal with Tycoon
years.p: Recorded at Shields's parents' house, with overdubs at Litton Lane, the demo gets the band signed. Ivers leaves and [[Tina Durkin|badc582a-9f69-4bac-a3dd-316954378311]] joins on keyboards.

years.h: Opening for R.E.M. in Tilburg
years.p: [[Virgin Prunes|16cb5325-3458-4845-b8d6-5933a2ec3166]] singer [[Gavin Friday|597c3e34-16f7-4e9a-81da-d6bda8b4d740]] tells the band to get out of Dublin. They move to the Netherlands and land a support slot with [[R.E.M.|ea4dfa26-f633-4da6-a52a-f49ea4897b58]] in Tilburg; visa trouble pushes them on to West Berlin by the end of the year.

years.h: A debut mini-album made in West Berlin
years.p: This Is Your Bloody Valentine comes out on Tycoon while the band are living in the divided city.

years.h: [[Debbie Googe|b482bb51-0019-4cbb-ba2a-77fa61211d27]] joins on bass, and Geek! follows
years.p: Back in London, Durkin loses touch during a hunt for a flat. Shields gets Googe's phone number through a London contact; the Geek! EP comes out on Fever in December.

eras.title: A new singer from a Dolly Parton audition
eras.text: The indie singles crept up the charts on three different small labels. Then Conway left, and the band found Bilinda Butcher, who had barely sung outside her own home.

years.h: Joe Foster's label puts out The New Record
years.p: The EP comes out on Kaleidoscope Sound, run by Creation's [[Joe Foster|6a850a84-6293-4788-9e05-ccd9fd4f0315]], and reaches No. 22 on the UK indie chart.

years.h: Conway quits to write
years.p: He cites stomach illness, disillusionment with music and wanting to be a writer.

years.cap: Bilinda Butcher at the front with My Bloody Valentine, Riverside, Newcastle
years.h: Butcher auditions with a Dolly Parton song
years.p: [[Bilinda Butcher|e16d25f4-a440-4e56-829d-326c20f5edd2]] gets the job singing Dolly Parton's The Bargain Store. Her experience: childhood classical guitar and singing for herself.

years.h: Ecstasy, paid for by the band
years.p: The self-funded mini-album reaches No. 12 on the indie albums chart despite mastering errors. Earlier in the year Sunny Sundae Smile, on [[The Primitives|9a407ae8-afbb-4a3a-abb1-1fab4b3c26af]]' label Lazy, made No. 6.

eras.title: Creation hears it in Canterbury
eras.text: Alan McGee saw them open for his own band and offered a record on the spot. In two years on Creation they made You Made Me Realise, Isn't Anything and Glider, and began the album that would take everything.

years.cap: Bilinda Butcher at the Riverside, Newcastle
years.h: Opening for Biff Bang Pow! in Canterbury, they get a Creation offer
years.p: Biff Bang Pow! is [[Alan McGee|ffacc13a-01e5-4b5d-a455-6a7f302ac9ce]]'s band. McGee, who runs Creation Records, invites My Bloody Valentine to make a record for the label.

yt: You Made Me Realise, official video
years.h: You Made Me Realise, cut in under a week in Walthamstow
years.p: Recorded in January in a small East London studio, the first Creation EP goes to No. 2 on the indie chart. The title track's noise break becomes the thing people come to the shows for.
years.xp: Live, the band stretch that break, nicknamed "the holocaust", into one chord held for around 15 minutes and, some nights, well over half an hour. [[Spacemen 3|19e818e4-0bbe-41fc-9589-c444b4165bf1]]'s Peter Kember saw them in 1988: "They'd transformed... The noise was overwhelming."

years.h: Two weeks in rural Wales on two hours' sleep a night
years.p: Isn't Anything is mostly recorded at Foel studio in Llanfair Caereinion. It tops the UK indie albums chart.
years.xp: Butcher described the routine: "Often, when we do the vocals, it's 7:30 in the morning: I've usually fallen asleep and have to be woken up to sing." NME's Stuart Maconie heard melodies glimpsed through sheets of blurred, opaque noise.

years.h: Five days booked at Blackwing for the second album
years.p: Sessions start at Blackwing Studios in Southwark. The five days stretch to two years and seven months.

years.src: Uncut: My Bloody Valentine · Wikipedia: Loveless
years.h: Ó Cíosóig faces eviction from his squat
years.p: Creation can't cover a £300 deposit for a flat. He has what he calls a nervous breakdown and drums on a handful of Loveless songs; the rest is built from his samples.
years.xp: His words to Uncut: "My brain to arm muscle control mechanism stopped working. I managed to get it together for a couple of songs." He plays on Only Shallow, Come in Alone and Loomer, and wrote and made Touched alone.

years.h: Soon leads off Glider
years.p: The EP reaches No. 2 on the indie chart and the band tour through the summer.

eras.title: Loveless, and who paid for it
eras.text: Loveless went through nineteen studios and a list of engineers before it came out in November 1991. Within weeks McGee had let the band go, and the argument over what it cost has run ever since.

yt: To Here Knows When, official video
years.h: Tremolo tops the indie chart
years.p: To Here Knows When leads the EP, the last release before the album.

years.src: Magnet: Kevin Shields · Uncut: My Bloody Valentine · Wikipedia: Loveless
years.h: Nineteen studios and three different price tags
years.p: The reported cost of Loveless is £250,000. Shields puts the real spend at £160,000 at most, mostly living money; that's his verdict on the bankrupted-Creation story.
years.xp:
McGee's figure for what the label spent is £15,000 to £20,000. Shields told Uncut the tapes were confiscated three or four times because Creation couldn't pay the bill, and that the label hunted cheap deals in rooms that weren't looked after.

He also stopped McGee coming to sessions, he told Magnet: "I don't want you to come to the studio anymore." Creation's Dick Green had a breakdown; a publicist said his hair turned grey overnight.

years.src: Wikipedia: Loveless · Uncut: My Bloody Valentine
years.h: Loveless comes out and reaches No. 24
years.p: Recorded February 1989 to September 1991 with Alan Moulder and Anjali Dutt among seven engineers. It misses the US chart entirely.
years.xp:
Butcher's vocals went down mostly in May and June 1991. She told Uncut that Shields gave her a guide vocal and she wrote down what she thought he'd sung. Shields and Butcher both developed tinnitus, which held up sessions.

Pitchfork named it the best album of the 1990s in 1999 and again in 2022; it won Mojo's Classic Album award in 2008.

q: It was either him or me.
years.h: McGee drops the band from Creation
years.p: He blames the endless sessions and his relationship with Shields.

years.h: Rollercoaster opens at the Glasgow SECC
years.p: The [[Jesus and Mary Chain|e938a15c-b17e-4e7a-9f68-ff0d536cab44]]'s package tour puts MBV on the bill with [[Dinosaur Jr.|77c167d2-4965-4421-830a-9815e4956475]] and [[Blur|ba853904-ae25-4ebb-89d6-c44cfbd71bd2]]. Each night the You Made Me Realise break holds one note for around ten minutes.

years.h: Island signs the band, reportedly for £250,000
years.p: The deal comes less than a year after Creation let them go.

eras.title: Chinchillas in Streatham
eras.text: The Island money bought a house in south London with a studio in it, and the next album kept not arriving. Googe and Ó Cíosóig left in 1995; by 1997 the band had stopped.

q: It was like the Partridge Family on acid.
years.src: Uncut: My Bloody Valentine · Wikipedia: My Bloody Valentine
years.h: The Streatham studio is finished. Then the desk dies
years.p: Shields told Uncut: house bought in January, paid for in March, studio done in June, then the desk failed. He called it a semi-meltdown.
years.xp: Googe remembered 13 or 14 chinchillas with the whole upstairs floor to themselves. That year the band also cut Louis Armstrong's We Have All the Time in the World for the Peace Together charity album.

years.h: Googe drives a taxi; Ó Cíosóig moves to America
years.p: Googe forms Snowpony with Katharine Gifford. Ó Cíosóig starts [[Hope Sandoval & the Warm Inventions|23f527e1-74ae-4f7c-94f3-4a5d5f379c51]] with [[Hope Sandoval|bc1cc75d-ab68-41b2-a135-3b62f41ea266]].

years.h: A Wire cover, and the third album begins
years.p: Shields and Butcher record [[Wire|7f2a8098-50e3-451c-8696-c5d9f64f4762]]'s Map Ref. 41°N 93°W for a tribute album. Shields later dates the start of the third album to this year.

years.h: The band goes dark
years.p: Shields becomes a touring member of [[Primal Scream|55704c38-224f-4b75-b29f-d43653f8bc9a]].

years.h: Reportedly 60 hours of tape delivered to Island
years.p: Butcher says there are probably enough songs to fill two albums. None of it is released.

years.h: Shields writes for Lost in Translation
years.p: Sofia Coppola's film carries Shields's new pieces and Sometimes from Loveless, and ends on the [[Jesus and Mary Chain|e938a15c-b17e-4e7a-9f68-ff0d536cab44]]'s Just Like Honey.

eras.title: Earplugs at the door
eras.text: Sixteen years after their last show, the four came back, and venues offered earplugs. Five years later the third album arrived, at midnight, on the band's own website.

years.h: Three UK shows, and talk of a third album
years.p: Shields says the record he started in 1996 is nearly done.

years.cap: My Bloody Valentine on stage, July 2008
years.h: First public performance in 16 years, at the ICA
years.p: Two live rehearsals in London start a world tour: Roskilde, Øya, Electric Picnic, Fuji Rock, and a run through Chicago, Toronto, Denver, San Francisco, Los Angeles and Austin.
years.xp:
The band spent £200,000 on touring equipment. The volume was the story, and venues handed out earplugs.

In September they curated All Tomorrow's Parties in New York, September 19-21.

years.h: Twenty-two years on, m b v goes up at midnight
years.p: Sold through the band's own website, it crashes the site within hours. Metacritic logs universal acclaim, and another world tour follows.

eras.title: Domino, and a Dublin return
eras.text: Promised EPs and a fourth album didn't come. The catalogue moved to Domino and onto streaming, and in late 2025 the band played again for the first time in seven years.

years.h: Desert Daze, then seven years off stage
years.p: Shields had talked about two EPs for 2019. The Desert Daze set turns out to be the last show until 2025.

years.h: Signed to Domino, the catalogue reaches streaming
years.p: Two days after a teaser reading "31 03", the band announce the deal; the 1988–2013 records go on streaming services worldwide for the first time.

years.cap: My Bloody Valentine at the National Stadium, Dublin, November 19, 2025
years.h: Back in Dublin, Off Your Face gets its first live airing
years.p: The first show in seven years is at the National Stadium: 19 songs, closing on You Made Me Realise, ahead of Manchester, London and Glasgow.
years.xp: Broken ticket scanners kept most of the crowd out until 9pm, Consequence reported, and some fans complained of equipment trouble. Dates in Asia and Primavera Sound in Barcelona were booked for 2026.

years.h: Most of the catalogue pulled from Israeli streaming
years.p: The band join the No Music for Genocide boycott.
